This [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as the '''waitress''' for the [[Unidentified Iziz cantina|Iziz Cantina]] in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to the [[Onderon Civil War]]. She was hired by [[Bahima]], the owner of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], following the repeated destruction of his [[Service droid/Legends|serving droids]]. Although she was not considered a great waitress by the cantina patrons, the [[Beast Riders]] enjoyed having her around for "entertainment." She was present at the cantina during [[Meetra Surik]]'s investigation into the murder of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sullio]].
